title: Repeated run
statement: Given a function $q$ from finite Boolean strings to optional values, a natural number $t$, and a finite Boolean string $w$, define the repeated run recursively as follows: if $0<t\leq |w|$, take the first available value among the result of applying $q$ to the length-$t$ prefix of $w$ and the repeated run of the remaining suffix; otherwise return no value.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ maps finite Boolean strings to optional values
